meta.name: higgsfield-generate
meta.description:
Generate images/videos/3D assets/audio via Higgsfield AI. Defaults:
GPT Image 2 for image/design/text, Seedance 2.0 for
video, Nano Banana 2/Lite/Pro for character/reference
images, Marketing Studio for ads, Seed Audio 1.0 for audio.
Use when: "generate an image", "make a video", "animate
this photo", "image-to-video", "edit/stylize/remix this
image", "reframe this video", "edit this video from a
sketch", "create a 3D model/GLB", "create a sound effect",
"make music", "text-to-audio", "create an ad", "make a UGC
video", "unboxing", "presenter video", "import product from
URL", or "analyze video virality". Supports image-to-3D
(`multi_image_to_3d`),
text-to-audio/music (`seed_audio`), workflow generation
(`draw_to_video`, `reframe`), Marketing Studio, and
Virality Predictor (`brain_activity`).
Chain with higgsfield-soul-id for face/identity consistency.
NOT for: Soul training, photoshoots, cards, explainers (use
higgsfield-video-explainer), playable games/assets (use
higgsfield-game-generation), or TTS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成图片、视频、3D模型和音频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成多种媒体内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate images, videos, 3D assets, and audio with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate various media content

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Higgsfield AI 生成图片、视频、3D 模型和音频。默认使用 GPT Image 2 生成图片，Seedance 2.0 生成视频，Seed Audio 1.0 生成音频。还支持广告制作、视频分析等功能。
howto.when: 当你要求“生成一张图片”、“制作一个视频”、“创建 3D 模型”、“生成音效”或“分析视频”等时触发。

say.text: 生成一张赛博朋克城市的图片，16:9 比例。
把这张照片变成 3D 模型。
say.note: Claude 会使用多图转 3D 功能生成 GLB 文件。

say.text: 分析这个广告视频的病毒式传播潜力。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate images, videos, 3D assets, and audio via Higgsfield AI. Defaults: GPT Image 2 for images, Seedance 2.0 for video, Seed Audio 1.0 for audio. Also supports ad creation and video analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'generate an image', 'make a video', 'create a 3D model', 'create a sound effect', or 'analyze a video'.

say_en.text: Generate a cyberpunk city image, 16:9 aspect ratio.
say_en.note: Claude will use GPT Image 2 to generate and return the link.

say_en.text: Turn this photo into a 3D model.
say_en.note: Claude will use multi-image-to-3D to create a GLB file.

say_en.text: Analyze this ad video for viral potential.
say_en.note: Claude will use Virality Predictor to return a score report.
